Provident Real Estate is proud to present this bright and spacious 1BR in Myrtle, located on corner side with an open boulevard view. This side of the building offers more privacy, natural light and zero construction noise, making the unit ideal for both end-users and investors.

Myrtle at Central Park is a new residential project by Meraas that presents you with a collection of luxury design apartments lined with premium facilities. These exclusive collections of homes are further boasted with every lifestyle needs and requirement, where you don’t have to take any extra stress.
